title: The Shiny Side Of Foil Is A Manufacturing Accident

scenes.narration: One side of aluminum foil is shiny and the other side is dull, and the box never explains why.
scenes.note: Both sides in one shot, catching light differently. The question is visual before it is spoken.

beats.action: Bill pulls a sheet of foil off a roll; it flashes on one face, matte on the other
the shiny face catches a highlight and labels itself
the sheet flips; the matte face labels itself
Bill turns the box over looking for an answer and finds nothing

scenes.narration: It is not a coating, and it is not a nonstick side.
scenes.note: Kill the two wrong answers fast so the real one has room. Crossed out, not argued with.

beats.action: a COATING label appears over the sheet and is crossed out
a NONSTICK label appears and is crossed out too

scenes.narration: Foil gets rolled thinner and thinner between polished steel rollers, and by the last pass it is so thin a single sheet would tear itself apart, so the mill runs two sheets through stacked together.
scenes.note: THE mechanism scene. The two-sheet pass is the whole episode — give it room and show it clearly.

beats.action: a rolling mill draws in; a thick aluminum ribbon feeds between two polished rollers
the ribbon passes through repeatedly, thinning at each pass
a single ultra-thin sheet enters alone and rips apart; the frame flinches
two sheets stack and enter together; they survive the pass
the ribbon emerges thinner and feeds back toward the rollers
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the ribbon makes another pass; the rollers squeeze it thinner again
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the torn single sheet curls away out of frame
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the paired sheets travel on together through the nip
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: The outer faces press against mirror-bright steel and come out shiny.
scenes.note: Cross-section at the roller nip. Outer faces touch steel.

beats.action: the nip enlarges into cross-section: roller, sheet, sheet, roller
the two outer faces glow against the polished steel and come out gleaming
the polished roller turns, holding its mirror finish against the sheet

scenes.narration: The two inner faces press against each other and come out dull.
scenes.note: The other half of the same frame. Then peel them apart — that is the payoff image.

beats.action: the two inner faces press together, matte where they meet
the sheets peel apart, each showing one shiny and one dull face
the pair separates fully and the episode hard cuts on the matched pair
the two sheets slide apart a few units, still face to face
